root_cause.text: The `hbh_mt6_check()` function in `net/ipv6/netfilter/ip6t_hbh.c` fails to validate that the user-supplied `optsnr` value is within the bounds of the fixed-size `opts` array in `struct ip6t_opts`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `if (optsinfo->optsnr > IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR)` in `hbh_mt6_check()` to reject oversized option lists, preventing an out-of-bounds array access on the `opts` array of size `IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR` (16).

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a boundary check to reject configurations with too many IPv6 options.
intent_record.what: An if-statement is added to check if optsinfo->optsnr exceeds IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR, returning -EINVAL if it does.
intent_record.how: This prevents potential out-of-bounds access or buffer overflows by validating the number of options before processing.
